title: Heat sensor open
fullDescription:
Asko dryers display F1 when the drum thermistor (NTC) reads open. The unit cannot regulate temperature and aborts the cycle.

Replace the thermistor and verify harness continuity.

faq.a: Air-fluff may run but no heated cycle.

title: Heat sensor shorted
fullDescription: F2 reports a shorted drum thermistor. Replace.

title: Moisture sensor fault
shortDescription: Conductivity bars not reading laundry humidity.
fullDescription:
F3 indicates the moisture sensor bars are not reading correctly. Lint coating or fabric softener residue is the typical cause.

Wipe the metal strips inside the drum with vinegar and a cloth.

faq.a: Yes - skip dryer sheets, they coat bars.

title: Heater circuit fault
fullDescription: F4 means the dryer is not detecting current draw on the heater circuit. Failed element, blown thermal fuse, or open relay are typical.

faq.a: Often blocked vent overheats and trips fuse.

title: Drum motor fault
shortDescription: Drive motor not turning at speed.
fullDescription: F5 indicates the drum drive motor is not running at the expected speed. Belt or motor issues common.

faq.a: Belts last about 10 years on average.

title: Condenser fan fault (heat pump)
fullDescription: F6 on heat-pump dryers indicates the condenser fan is below RPM threshold. Lint blockage or motor failure.

title: Water tank full (heat pump)
fullDescription: F7 indicates the condensate tank is full and not draining. Empty the tank or check the drain hose if plumbed.

title: Door switch fault
fullDescription: F8 means the door switch is not registering closure. Check switch alignment or replace.

faq.a: Just close firmly - do not slam.

title: Communication error
fullDescription: F9 indicates loss of communication between display and main control. Reset and check harness.

title: Lint filter cleaning required
fullDescription: F0 is a maintenance reminder to clean the lint filter and the secondary fluff filter.

fixSteps.title: Clean filters
fixSteps.instruction: Pull lint trap, rinse fluff filter under tap.

faq.a: Every cycle for the lint trap.
